content.title: Denmark Accuses Russia of Plotting to Assassinate US-Ukrainian Rapper
content.caption: Denmark accuses Russian intelligence services of plotting to assassinate a Ukrainian-American rapper in Copenhagen.

slides.heading: Denmark Accuses Russia of Plotting to Assassinate US-Ukrainian Rapper
slides.text: Denmark accuses Russian intelligence services of plotting to assassinate a Ukrainian-American rapper in Copenhagen.

slides.heading: Assassination Attempt Details
slides.text: The rapper's real name is Albert Vasiliev. PET stopped individuals intending to kill him at a concert in September.

slides.heading: Expulsion of Russian Defence Attaché
slides.text: Russia's defence attaché must leave Denmark within seven days.
